items.title: Meta Introduces Custom Spaces in Muse (3 minute read)
items.snippet: Meta introduced Spaces in its Muse app, allowing users to create personalized interactive experiences by describing what they want, such as gift trackers, games, or project planners.

items.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science (13 minute read)
items.snippet: OpenAI introduced BioBasicsBench, a benchmark to evaluate AI performance in interpreting raw experimental data from 100 routine wet-lab science tasks.

items.title: When Does the US Become a Net Importer of Tokens?
items.snippet: US AI demand grows from 66gw in 2027 while tokens per watt compound 2.9x a year, so the grid only binds if token demand outruns efficiency. Break-even real token growth is ~2.5x a year with no cancell
